_comment: Organizations OpenMined works with (affiliations, partners, press): third-party marks, NOT OpenMined assets and NOT governed by OMDS tokens, used nominatively. The registry: `color` = the logo in its owner's colors, as supplied (never recolored; shown on a white plate); `mono` = a checked one-color file in currentColor, for a section that follows the color mode (src/lib/orgs.ts checks it every build; omitted for detailed seals and multi-color marks); `roles` = what the organization is to OpenMined (partner, press); `source` = where the files came from; Add or update with `npm run logos:import`. Tools and services we use are a separate set (logos/tools/). Gap: Christchurch Call has no public vector (JPG only); request it from the Christchurch Call Foundation.
